data.name: Erfanun
data.gender_notes: Erfanun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'arf' meaning 'to know'. Erfanun refers to the attainment of deep knowledge and wisdom through personal experience and practice. The name Erfanun carries the meaning “Knowledge, wisdom” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Erfanun usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledge, wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Erfanun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledge, wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Erfanun total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
